cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Reveal the Truth in Layers
cards.instruction: Protect someone by disclosing the truth in stages, changing what each earlier statement appears to mean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The wedding venue has made a small change.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What changed?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. The date remains available. The building does not.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What happened to the building?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A fire. Let's hold onto the available date while we choose what comes next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For a wedding cake, we weigh the flour. Please put that mug down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's quicker. I've used three mugs already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right. Show me the mug, and I'll weigh one mugful.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I used three different mugs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Please fetch all three. Apparently we're measuring the crockery before we can measure the flour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm tuning this piano. Please leave the keys alone while I listen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm checking the sticky ones so you can fix those too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Mark them with these little stickers. Silently, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Done. Shall I peel them off so you can play?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One at a time. After I reach each key. We've nearly invented a system.

beats.text: Your garden gnome is coming home in a different arrangement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What arrangement?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Several pieces, carefully packed. I wanted you to hear 'coming home' first.

cards.title: Confess Around Them
cards.instruction: Use partial admissions to make a reciprocal confession feel like the only missing piece.

beats.speaker: B

beats.text: Why didn't you tell me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I should have. Now tell me where your half of the meeting went.

cards.title: It Was Foreshadowed
cards.instruction: Turn the failure into a planned turning point by returning to earlier details that now appear to predict it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. The empty stand pays off the warning beautifully.

cards.title: Be Right in Retrospect
cards.instruction: Perform certainty by reinterpreting every surprise as something your earlier words were obviously predicting.

beats.text: You didn't predict a burst pipe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I said we'd need to open up. The plumbing listened first.
